verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no split-inbox or focused-streams feature that separates important, team, newsletter, and calendar-invite mail into priority-ordered views. What it does show are adjacent pieces: shared team inboxes, team spaces, label sync, and up to 1000 rules. A user could combine rules and labels to approximate streams, but that is a building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
